title: CIA and ODNI reportedly discover breach exposing some unclassified information, NYT reports
date_note: The pages give only the publication day of the New York Times report; the intrusion date is not stated.
org: CIA / Office of the Director of National Intelligence
geo_basis: US federal agencies named in the source; Washington, D.C. used, no site stated
summary: According to the New York Times, citing a person familiar with the matter, the CIA and ODNI recently discovered a breach that exposed some unclassified information. Reuters says the intrusions hit a network used to gather intelligence from public sources, and the Times reported other agencies were also believed exposed. ODNI said there were no disruptions to critical capabilities or classified systems. Fox News, citing its own sources, says the issue has been resolved.
plain: The New York Times, citing people familiar with the matter, reports a breach at the CIA and ODNI that exposed some unclassified information. ODNI told Reuters classified systems were not disrupted.
exec: A reported breach of a US intelligence analysis network exposed some unclassified information; what was taken is unclear, per the reports.
impact: What data was taken is unclear, according to the Reuters relay of the NYT report.

sources.name: WTVB (Reuters, relaying the New York Times)
Cedar News (Reuters, relaying the New York Times)

validation.note: Reuters (relayed by WTVB and Cedar News, one publisher) and Fox News (own unnamed sources besides the NYT) each state the CIA/ODNI breach; ODNI statement quoted by Reuters. The NYT page was not read. AP (via The Star, read 25 Nov) cites its own anonymous person familiar, who says the breach did not involve classified information and has been resolved.

review.note: summary over 75 words trimmed; other agencies may have been affected aligned to the Times 'believed exposed'; validation note; checked against Reuters relay (WTVB) and Fox News
